summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running tests or repository code, and without committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and widens ControlCode with Tuple[ControlType, str]; rich/control.py adds the format entry emitting ESC ] 0 ; title BEL and the Control.title classmethod; rich/console.py adds set_window_title (gated only on is_terminal, returns bool, Google-style docstring); rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that calls term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gains an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200; tests added in test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py. Not verified: pytest, mypy, and black were not run, per the instructions.
